selection_rule: cross-seed median validation BCE, chosen from validation results only, before any test evaluation
architecture: TinyNet(input_dim=68, hidden=32), 2 hidden layers, ReLU, single logit output (apply sigmoid for probability)

input_contract.name: candidate_features
input_contract.encoding: 48-dim board block + 20-dim candidate block, per encode.ts's encodeState/encodeCandidateFeatures -- see EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md for offsets. Batch dim N is dynamic (exported with dynamic_axes) -- N=1 for a single candidate, N>1 for a batched session.run() call as evaluateCandidateRows() in onnx.ts does.

output_contract.name: logit
output_contract.note: raw logit per row, NOT a probability -- apply sigmoid(a*logit + b) with this seed's Platt parameters below for a calibrated probability

target: legal_pot_rate (empirical fraction of perturbed rollouts where the candidate legally pots its intended ball)

test_metrics_all_seeds_mean.note: reported for the 5-seed ensemble, not this specific exported seed alone -- see TRAINING_REPORT.md

known_limitations: double-bank candidates: this exported seed's (20260804) own group-aware Spearman is 0.0600 (val) / 0.0447 (test) -- far below the pooled figure and, on validation, over the protocol's predeclared catastrophic-kind threshold (see ABLATIONS.md; the 5-seed-ensemble mean is a materially different, less alarming number and is NOT what this specific artifact was measured at). Do not rely on this artifact's output to rank double-bank candidates with confidence; fall back to the candidate-kind-mean baseline or the transparent heuristic for that kind.
No hyperparameter search was performed (frozen architecture, per protocol) -- this is a first defensible baseline, not a tuned model.
Not wired into live gameplay -- this is a standalone artifact for Stage B.9 parity/latency testing only, per the protocol's explicit scope exclusion of Phase 2F.
